title: sequin table runner
text: sequin table runner. Purchased this for a restaurant bday party to add a little flair to an otherwise ordinary meal... it was nice and sparkly... a few sequins came off though... it's not washable really.  My Mom's opinion was it could be as a shawl?  It think it would be scratchy myself...  Measurements given are accurate.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: 12''x72'' Sequin Table Runner Sparkly Metallic Sequin Runner for Wedding Party Dinner Reception, Event Bridalwedding Runner, Birthday Party, Dinner Party, Shower Ready to Ship! (1, Purple)
features: Table Runner: 1pc 12x72-inch purple sequin table runner. This rectangle table cover can fit a 6ft rectangular table or round table well. This sparkly table cover is great for event table decorations.
Sequin Table Runer: Made of high density sequin fabric,countless sparkle sequins on mesh fabric, the table runners are not see through.

Table Runner for Dining Room: This sparkly table covers are well made by skillful craftsmen. All the edges of the glitz table runners are well finished. It's normal for a few sequins fall off. Please shake the sequin table runner a little before use.

Table Runner for Party: Our glitter table runners are designed for a variety of happy occasions: suitable for your dining-room table, kitchen table, Cafes, restaurants, diners, catering, weddings, brunches, buffets, parties, picnics, outdoor patio table and more.
Care Instruction of Wedding Table Runner: This sparkle table runner can be washed by hands in cold water,and hang to dry. Sequin table runners are durable and can be used again and again.
